basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Product Engineer | Full-Stack + UX | Developer Experience | 3x Founder
basics.summary: Full-stack product engineer who ships end to end and cares about how it feels. 13+ years building for 10M+ users, from Beekeeper's Employee Referral System ($1.5M+ revenue, top platform channel) to AI outbound at LumApps (2x conversions, $1M forecast). TypeScript across the stack, observability and debug UX baked in from day one, product decisions grounded in customer conversations, not vibes. Also run Anand Creations, my own practice where I design, build, and ship developer-facing AI products (PulseView, Proplab, SwissNRI) solo. Remote-native, default to action.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Own AI outbound end to end: agent architecture on Python and TypeScript, UI streamed over AG-UI, tools over MCP, and the debug/trace experience reps use to see exactly what the agent did and why. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

Built the observability layer for AI in production: LangSmith tracing, cost-per-request telemetry, and eval pipelines that reflect real usage. Same craft that turns opaque model calls into something reps and PMs can actually understand.
Report directly to C-level on outcomes. Talk to reps and PMs weekly, turn ambiguous complaints into shippable UI and API changes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end to end (TypeScript/Vue frontend, Java backend, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search on Kubernetes). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR. Owned product thinking, UX, launch, and iteration.
Designed distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90%. Powers 15% of all assets for 10M+ users. Zero-to-live in minutes, not days, because the UX was designed for it.
Ran observability and global on-call (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting. Built the debug experience I wanted product engineers to have.
Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off. Shipped the full autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue frontend, Java backend, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries. Every screen designed by me, tested with real ops teams.
Built AWS infra and CI/CD from scratch. Enterprise reliability that enabled a Unilever partnership and a CES Las Vegas showcase.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
projects.description: My independent practice and the home for AI products I design, build, and run myself (SwissNRI, Proplab, PulseView). Every screen, API, and email flow shipped by me solo. Same standards I bring to Resend-scale product surfaces: clarity, speed, and observability the user actually sees.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence for retail traders. TypeScript across the stack, live-streaming UI, and an explainability layer that shows exactly why each trading signal fired. If the model can't justify the signal in the UI, it doesn't ship.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: AI-native MVP for property inspections. Vision pipeline extracts structured signals from photos; LLM agents turn them into multilingual, marketing-ready listings. One workflow from photo capture to published listing, zero copy-paste. Full product surface designed and shipped solo.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Product Engineer at Resend (modern email API for developers, 3M+ devs, 100% remote, backed by a16z + YC). Full-stack + UX role: shape core product experience, own features end to end (product thinking, UX, implementation, instrumentation, launch, iteration), build debug/observability UX for emails/webhooks/domains/API requests, talk to users, raise the bar on craft/performance/accessibility/reliability. Stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js. 6+ years shipping web products. Great fit: product judgment, DX obsession, low ego, default to action, hands-on. Exceptional fit: dev/infra product experience, email/DNS/webhooks/API platform experience, visual taste, small high-ownership teams.
_jobApplication.notes: React is not my primary frontend framework (Vue is), but I've used it via AG-UI at LumApps and I have deep TypeScript + microfrontends experience. Emphasized full-stack + product ownership + observability UX + solo-shipped founder projects.
